claims.claim_text: The indexed William L. Buckland is confirmed as the Army entrant represented by the exact-name and private-identifier match in the official merged file.

claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact private identifier and exact normalized full name.

claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded to Army entry on March 16, 1943; the relation to OSS recruitment is unknown.
